h1: Indochina Hotel Aranyaprathet — Big Pool, New Rooms, Great Value Near Rong Kluea Market
intro: If you're here to shop Rong Kluea Market, cross the border at Khlong Luek, or break a journey before Poipet, Indochina Hotel Aranyaprathet is a name many travelers are surprised by — it delivers more than the price suggests · A 3.5-star hotel with Thai-Chinese design, new spacious clean rooms, and a large outdoor saltwater pool that many reviews call the biggest in the area, plus a frequently praised breakfast and free parking · Rooms start from about THB 1,400/night for a Deluxe, a genuinely good-value choice for anyone who wants a pool and new rooms without paying much.

body.html: Indochina Hotel Aranyaprathet sits at 154 Moo 6, Thana Withi Road, Ban Mai Nong Sai, Aranyaprathet, Sa Kaeo — in the Aranyaprathet area, near Rong Kluea Market and the Khlong Luek border crossing over to Poipet on the Cambodian side · It's a hotel of around 116 rooms with Thai-Chinese design, a central pool courtyard, 24-hour reception, a restaurant and a bar · TripAdvisor ranks it #1 of 7 hotels in Aranyaprathet, from over 101 reviews.

What guests mention most is the large outdoor swimming pool · Many reviews say it's bigger than expected for a small-town hotel, with some calling it Olympic-sized; it's a saltwater pool with attractive landscaping and patio areas around it · The other consistent compliment is the new, spacious, clean rooms — many guests say it feels like a brand-new hotel, with strong hot-water showers, comfortable beds, and a quiet night's sleep.
"The room was huge and brand-new, spotlessly clean, the biggest pool in the area, and the breakfast was better than expected — great value for a hotel near the border."

Breakfast is another frequent highlight, with both Asian and Western options, and many guests say it's heartier and tastier than they expected at this price · The staff are friendly and attentive, with warm welcomes and help arranging taxis and border information · There's the Rachawadee restaurant serving Thai food, free parking, and free Wi-Fi — enough for an overnight stop or a multi-night stay while shopping Rong Kluea Market.

The honest caveats — there's a live band in the evenings that plays until late, and some reviews complain about the noise early in the night, so if you sleep light, ask for a room facing the parking lot, which is quieter · The other point is that the hotel is a fair way from the Khlong Luek border and Rong Kluea Market — you'll need a ride, you can't walk it, so allow travel time if you plan an early border crossing · A few guests also note the shower hot-cold controls are confusing with no English labels, and that some breakfast dishes arrive a little cold.

In short, Indochina Hotel Aranyaprathet suits anyone shopping Rong Kluea Market, crossing to Poipet, or wanting a hotel with a pool at a great price · An overall score of about 8.9 from real reviews reflects exactly that — new clean rooms, a big pool, good breakfast and lovely staff, traded against evening band noise and a location that needs a ride to the border · Ask for a quiet room and allow travel time, and most guests have a comfortable stay and feel it's great value.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Indochina Hotel Aranyaprathet, Sa Kaeo

faq.q: Where is Indochina Hotel Aranyaprathet — is it near Rong Kluea Market?
faq.a: It's at 154 Moo 6, Thana Withi Road, Ban Mai Nong Sai, Aranyaprathet, Sa Kaeo · About a 10-minute drive from Rong Kluea Market and the Khlong Luek border crossing to Poipet · You'll need a ride — it's not walkable — but the front desk can arrange one.

faq.q: What's the starting price and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from about THB 1,400/night for a Deluxe (24 sqm) · There's a Junior Twin Suite around THB 1,700, a Honeymoon Suite with bathtub around THB 2,200, and a Grand Suite around THB 2,800 · Prices vary by season, so compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is there a swimming pool — how big is it?
faq.a: Yes, there's a large outdoor saltwater pool, which many reviews call the biggest in Aranyaprathet — some describe it as Olympic-sized — with attractive landscaping and patio areas around it, great for taking the kids in.

faq.q: What are the rooms and breakfast like?
faq.a: Rooms are new, spacious and clean, with many guests saying it feels like a brand-new hotel and strong hot showers · Breakfast has both Asian and Western options, hearty and frequently praised, though a few dishes can arrive a little cold.
Bear in mind there's a live band in the evenings until late, noisy early in the night · If you sleep light, ask for a room facing the parking lot, which several reviews say is quieter.

faq.q: Who is this hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits anyone shopping Rong Kluea Market, crossing to Poipet, or wanting a hotel with a pool at a great price · Great for families wanting a pool and travelers who value new clean rooms over being right at the border.
